question: למה T015I לא התגלתה?

hypothesis.description: מגזר החסימה SEC-7 (35°–50°) נשאר פעיל במצב האפקטיבי של המכ״ם בזמן המעבר, למרות שהתצוגה הציגה ביטול; לכן הגילוי דוכא.
הכיסוי או פקודת החיפוש (req-202, SEARCH_WIDE) לא יצרו טווח/גזרה אפקטיביים שכוללים את מיקום המטרה (42°, 26 ק״מ), או שהבקשה נדחתה/לא יושמה.

arguments.question: Within the window 2026-10-14T12:00:00Z to 12:10:05Z for case_005: (1) Run inspect_region with the report badge [case_report.txt:L1] (azimuth 42 deg, range 26 km, uncertainty 1 deg / 0.5 km, window 12:03:55Z-12:04:25Z) to get absence/coverage, detection counts and the calculation_citation. (2) Using reconstruct_state, report the effective InhibitSectorState and RadarState (search bounds, pattern, receiver status) at 12:03:55Z, 12:04:10Z and 12:04:25Z, and whether the SEC-7 inhibit sector (35-50 deg) was enabled. (3) Use trace_request for req-101, req-202, req-303 and req-505 and report the receipt/application acknowledgements, the schema_id used, and whether each was APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED or only received. (4) Report the SoftwareVersion records for radar-psr-01, config-service, control-gateway and operator-ui if available. Return exact source badges and calculation handles.
arguments.hypothesis: H1: SEC-7 inhibit sector remained effective after the operator cancel (display open, effective suppression), suppressing detections at 42 deg. H2: the search request req-202 or cancel req-303 was not applied/schema-incompatible, so the radar kept old pattern or bounds; or the target was simply outside the effective search bounds.

arguments.question: (1) Run inspect_region for the coordinator report, citing it exactly as "case_report.txt:L1" (the previous attempt with "[case_report.txt:L1]" returned Unknown report citation; if that fails, try "case_report.txt" with line 1). Geometry: azimuth 42 deg +/-1, range 26 km +/-0.5, window 2026-10-14T12:03:55Z-12:04:25Z. Report coverage (message types, all-target, spatially unfiltered, recorder drops), Detection/TargetTrack counts inside the region, and the calculation_citation. (2) Run reconstruct_state at 2026-10-14T12:08:00Z and 12:08:10Z (repeat pass window) to report the effective InhibitSectorState SEC-7 and RadarState bounds/pattern. (3) Run inspect_region for the repeat-pass report "operator_diary.csv:L7" (window 12:08:00Z-12:08:10Z, same geometry) and report coverage, detection counts in the region and calculation_citation. Also give the sniffer.csv rows where SEC-7 becomes enabled=false after req-505 if visible.
arguments.hypothesis: H1: during 12:03:55-12:04:25Z, the effective SEC-7 inhibit sector (35-50 deg, enabled) suppressed Detection/TargetTrack output at the reported 42 deg / 26 km position, so no detection appeared although the search scanned it. After req-505 disabled SEC-7 (12:07:15), a detection at the repeat pass should be possible. Alternative H2: the target was outside effective bounds or absent from capture.

arguments.question: Use inspect_region with the exact report identifier "case_report.txt:1" (the report's id field; earlier attempts with "case_report.txt:L1" or "[case_report.txt:L1]" failed as Unknown report citation). Geometry: centre azimuth 42 deg (uncertainty +/-1 deg), range 26 km (+/-0.5 km), window 2026-10-14T12:03:55Z to 12:04:25Z. Report: coverage (message types, all-target, spatially unfiltered, recorder drops), Detection and TargetTrack counts inside the region, whether the region was inside the SEC-7 inhibit sector (35-50 deg, 0-80 km) and scanned by SEARCH_WIDE (30-65 deg), and the calculation_citation. Then do the same with report identifier "operator_diary.csv:7" for window 2026-10-14T12:08:00Z to 12:08:10Z.
arguments.hypothesis: H1: the reported 42 deg / 26 km location was inside effective SEC-7 suppression during 12:03:55-12:04:25Z, so zero Detection/TargetTrack records appear there despite the scan; at the repeat pass 12:08:00-12:08:10Z, after SEC-7 was disabled at 12:07:15Z, a detection is expected in the same region. H2: capture coverage is incomplete or the region is outside scanned bounds.

arguments.question: Without inspect_region (it has failed for every report identifier), count Detection and TargetTrack records in the sniffer/radar feed whose azimuth is within 41-43 deg and range within 25.5-26.5 km, for (a) 2026-10-14T12:03:55Z to 12:04:25Z and (b) 2026-10-14T12:08:00Z to 12:08:10Z. Use analyze_fields or query_events with an azimuth/range filter if available; otherwise list all Detection/TargetTrack rows in each window and check azimuth/range yourself. Also report whether any record in (a) has target identifier T015I or equivalent. Report the total count, the matching row locators and the query handle. Also report the capture_manifest coverage (message types, spatial filter, recorder drops) with its badge.
arguments.hypothesis: H1: no Detection/TargetTrack appears near 42 deg/26 km during 12:03:55-12:04:25Z (consistent with SEC-7 suppression), while a detection appears there during the 12:08 repeat pass after SEC-7 was disabled. H2: detections exist but are mis-geolocated or filtered.

findings.title: חסימת SEC-7 פעילה במערכת בזמן המעבר
findings.claim: השעות מקומיות. בין 15:03:55 ל-15:04:25 מקטע החסימה SEC-7 (35°–50°) היה פעיל במערכת בפועל וכיסה את המיקום המדווח (42°, 26 ק״מ). הסריקה כיסתה את הגזרה, ולא נרשם גילוי באזור. ייתכן שהחסימה מנעה הפקת גילוי שם.
findings.rationale: UTC 12:03:55–12:04:25. ה-InhibitSectorState האפקטיבי היה enabled=true באזור 35–50° ו-0–80 ק״מ ב-12:03:55, 12:04:10 ו-12:04:25. מצב התצוגה הראה כבוי באותם רגעים, ולכן התצוגה והמצב האפקטיבי נחלקו. הקטלוג קובע שמקטע פעיל מדכא Detection/TargetTrack בתחומו. ספירת אפס הגילויים נעשתה ידנית על פלט query_events, ו-inspect_region נכשל בכל מזהה דיווח, לכן אין חישוב אזורי מלא. זו סיבה סבירה, לא מדידה ישירה של הדיכוי. הכיסוי בקטלוג מוגדר שלם ללא נפילות הקלטה.
